name: Festival of Ba Chua Xu
nameVi: Lễ hội Vía Bà Chúa Xứ Núi Sam
summary: The festival of Bà Chúa Xứ at Núi Sam runs on the fourth lunar month, with a palanquin, a bathing rite for the statue, and offerings. UNESCO and the 2026 culture-department article say the 22nd to the 27th. TITC prints the 23rd to the 27th. An older national-tourism item prints the night of 23/4 through 27/4. In 2026 the ward mapped the rites to 6–12 June, and a wider program to 3 May–7 June. Later civil dates are check on arrival. The photograph is the shrine at dusk on 1 April 2014, not the palanquin.
when: 22–27 of the fourth lunar month (UNESCO and the 2026 culture department). TITC prints 23–27. An older page prints the night of 23/4 through 27/4. 2026 rites: 6–12 June. Later years: check on arrival.
